violations.text: Pan were observed in the hand-washing sink. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/21/2026

Raw animal foods (beef and shelled eggs) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (produce) in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/21/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (ice machine) were observed with an accumulation of black residue. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/21/2026

(Various food product) was observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/07/2026

The screen and door to the outside, located in the (kitchen ), is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/04/2026

Various food product were observed stored on the floor in the (walk in cooler, kitchen, and back storage area ). Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/07/2026
The condensate from the cookline prep unit is draining into a container. Condensate drainage and other nonsewage liquids must drain into a drain. New Violation. Correct By: 07/21/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the (kitchen and back storage) area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/21/2026

Soap was not available at the hand-washing sink in the kitchen. Hand-washing sinks must be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/07/2026
Drink pitcher were observed in the hand-washing sink. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/07/2026

Raw animal foods (shelled eggs) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (produce) in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/07/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (ice machine) were observed with an accumulation of black residue. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Unit take out of service to be washed and sanitized. Ice disposed. New Violation. Correct By: 07/07/2026

Ground beef was observed held at (119) degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling.PIC reheated to 165 or above. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/07/2026

Various food product was observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 07/07/2026

(ROP fish ) was observed thawing on the 3 reach in cooler with package intact. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must be thawed in one of the following manners: under refrigeration (41 degrees Fahrenheit or less); completely submerged under running water; as part of the cooking process; or in the microwave if cooked immediately after thawing. PIC voluntarily disposed of product.PIC informed of proper ROP seafood procedures. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/07/2026

Working containers of (dry ingredients ) are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. New Violation. Correct By: 07/07/2026

The door to the outside, located in the (kitchen ), is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 07/07/2026

Various food product were observed stored on the floor in the (walk in cooler, kitchen, and back storage area ). Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 07/07/2026

Bowls are being used as scoops in containers of cooked foods and dried foods. Utensils used to dispense non-time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods such as sugar and flour must be stored in the food item with their handles above the top of the food within the container. New Violation. Correct By: 07/07/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the (kitchen and back storage) area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 07/21/2026

Raw animal foods (raw beef, raw ground meat, and raw eggs) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (produce, beans, soup) in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. PIC removed raw meats. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 02/11/2025

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (chopper) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. PIC moved chopper to 3 bay sink to be washed and sanitized. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 02/11/2025

Tomato based salsas (made on site) was observed held between 105-109 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC reheated. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 02/11/2025

Cooked shredded pork was observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 02/11/2025

The door to the outside, located in the back kitchen, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 01/09/2025
The non-food contact surfaces of the chorizo stuffer have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 02/11/2025

The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was blocked by a stack of cases. A hand-washing sink shall be accessible at all times for employee use. PIC removed items. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 01/22/2025

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (slicer) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. PIC took slicer out of service. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 01/22/2025

Salsa, which was prepared in advance, was not cooled to 70 degrees Fahrenheit in 2 hours and then to 41 degrees Fahrenheit within 4 hours. PIC discarded. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 01/22/2025

Black beans and rice was observed held between 71 - 110 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC reheated. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 01/22/2025

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Per interview of PIC, salsa was placed hot in the refrigerator in containers greater than four inches deep and large, deep pot of beans were cooling at room temperature in the kitchen. PIC discarded the salsa and reheated the beans. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 01/22/2025

The door to the outside, located in the kitchen, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 01/09/2025
Inspector observed various food items stored in non-food grade plastic containers and plastic bag. PIC informed and removed rice from plastic bag. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 01/22/2025
The non-food contact surfaces of the slicer have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 01/22/2025
Mops must be allowed to air dry after use. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 01/09/2025

Empty bottles were observed in the hand-washing sink. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. PIC removed bottles. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 01/09/2025

Raw animal foods (such as raw meats) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (such as cooked vegetables) in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. PIC rearranged walk-in. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 01/09/2025

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (can opener and slicer) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Units taken out of service to be thoroughly cleaned and sanitized. New Violation. Correct By: 01/09/2025
Working containers used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies were not marked with the common name of the chemical. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 01/09/2025
Inspector observed ROP fish being thawed under refrigeration. The temperature of the fish was 37 degrees Fahrenheit. PIC opened ROP packaging. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 01/09/2025

The door to the outside, located in the kitchen, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 01/09/2025
Inspector observed various food items stored in plastic shopping bags. PIC informed to use proper food grade storge bags/containers. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 01/09/2025

Inspector observed corn husks being soaked in a bowl in the 3 bay sink. PIC to stop practice and soak corn husks in a bowl on the counter or food prep sink. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 01/09/2025

Inspector observed staff washing a coffee pot in the mop sink. PIC notified that the mop sink is only intended for dumping mop water. Staff washed coffee pot in 3 bay sink. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 01/09/2025
Cleaned and sanitized equipment (pots) are not stored inverted. New Violation. Correct By: 01/09/2025
The non-food contact surfaces of the prep units have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 01/09/2025
Mops must be allowed to air dry after use. New Violation. Correct By: 01/09/2025

Employees' clothing or other personal belongings were observed stored in the kitchen area. Lockers or other suitable facilities shall be used for the orderly storage of employees' clothing and other possessions. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 01/09/2025
Handwashing sinks in the kitchen are lacking signage. New Violation. Correct By: 12/11/2024

The ice scoop is stored on an unclean surface (top of the ice machine) between uses. During pauses in food preparation, utensils must be stored on a clean surface or in a clean, protected location. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 12/11/2024

Wood is used in the construction of (kitchen door frame and handwashing sink ) in the (kitchen area ) area. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other food soiling or that require frequent cleaning must be constructed of a nonabsorbent and smooth material. New Violation. Correct By: 12/18/2024
The non-food contact surfaces of the (cookline prep units and fans in walk in cooler ) have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 12/11/2024

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (can opener, ice machine, knives, dough mixer) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 12/10/2024

The presence of (roaches ) is not controlled as evidenced by (live activity and dead). The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. New Violation. Correct By: 12/10/2024

The door to the outside, located in the (kitchen ), is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 12/10/2024
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the (chlorine) sanitizing solution for the (dishwasher). New Violation. Correct By: 12/06/2024

The non-food contact surfaces of the (prep tables, counter lowboys,counter shelves, food carts) have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 12/10/2024

The floors throughout the kitchen and walk in cooler have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 12/06/2024

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items, litter and other debris were observed in the (outside dumpster) area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 12/06/2024
